firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently sang in the shower starts, or choose a first player by any other method.
clarifications: Place the first player’s guitar-pick turn-order token on the first space; the remaining players fill the track clockwise.
Starting with the first player, each player draws two Character cards and chooses one simultaneously with the others.
